{
	"name": "pi-action",
	"version": "2.2.0",
	"description": "GitHub Action to invoke the pi coding agent on issues and PRs",
	"keywords": [
		"ai",
		"automation",
		"coding-agent",
		"github-action",
		"pi"
	],
	"homepage": "https://github.com/cv/pi-action#readme",
	"bugs": {
		"url": "https://github.com/cv/pi-action/issues"
	},
	"license": "MIT",
	"author": "Carlos Villela",
	"repository": {
		"type": "git",
		"url": "git+https://github.com/cv/pi-action.git"
	},
	"type": "module",
	"scripts": {
		"build": "tsc -p tsconfig.build.json",
		"test": "vitest run",
		"test:watch": "vitest",
		"coverage": "vitest run --coverage",
		"check": "npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run coverage && npm run analyze",
		"lint": "oxlint --type-aware --deny-warnings --report-unused-disable-directives && oxfmt --check && npm run lint:actions",
		"analyze": "knip --treat-config-hints-as-errors && jscpd --config .jscpd.json src",
		"fix": "oxfmt && oxlint --type-aware --fix && oxfmt",
		"lint:actions": "node scripts/lint-actions.mjs",
		"typecheck": "tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc",
		"prepare": "prek install --allow-missing-config --hook-type pre-commit --hook-type commit-msg --hook-type prepare-commit-msg --hook-type pre-push"
	},
	"dependencies": {
		"@actions/core": "^3.0.1",
		"@actions/github": "^9.1.1",
		"@earendil-works/chord": "1.5.2",
		"@earendil-works/pi-ai": "1.5.2",
		"@earendil-works/pi-durable": "1.5.2",
		"jiti": "^2.6.1"
	},
	"devDependencies": {
		"@commitlint/cli": "^21.2.2",
		"@commitlint/config-conventional": "^21.2.2",
		"@j178/prek": "^0.4.14",
		"@octokit/webhooks-types": "^7.6.1",
		"@types/node": "^26.2.0",
		"@vitest/coverage-v8": "^4.1.10",
		"actionlint": "^2.0.6",
		"jscpd": "^5.0.16",
		"knip": "^6.32.2",
		"oxfmt": "0.78.0",
		"oxlint": "1.93.0",
		"oxlint-tsgolint": "7.0.2006",
		"typescript": "^7.0.2",
		"vitest": "^4.1.10"
	},
	"engines": {
		"node": ">=24.0.0"
	}
}
